new_source_directions: Use the latest NVIDIA Form 10-Q filed on or before 2026-07-12 as a customer regulatory-document route distinct from the previously searched annual report.

Require the full filing to name both SK hynix and HBM when interpreting inventory purchase obligations, capacity agreements, advance payments, duration, or cancellation terms; otherwise keep DURABLE_VISIBILITY unresolved.

suggested_queries.literal_query: SK hynix NVIDIA 2026 Form 10-Q HBM inventory purchase obligations capacity agreements
suggested_queries.rationale: Prior search covered NVIDIA fiscal 2026 annual report, while the latest Form 10-Q available on or before the cutoff is a distinct current-period regulatory document class. Review its inventory purchase obligations, capacity agreements, and related advance-payment language only for an explicit joint attribution to SK hynix and HBM; generic NVIDIA commitments or unnamed suppliers do not resolve the objective.

unresolved_research_notes: The quarterly filing may disclose only aggregate or unnamed-supplier commitments. Do not infer SK hynix or HBM attribution from NVIDIA-wide purchase obligations.
